kbToModel.title: KB text to the AI model
kbToModel.description: "approved": Apty KB card text may go to an AI destination the allow-lists permit. "off" (the default): card text is shown in the panel only.

kbToMcp.title: KB text to the MCP bridge
kbToMcp.description: Whether search_kb results reach a local MCP client with their card text. Default false.

allowedProviders.title: Allowed AI providers
allowedProviders.description: Provider keys the user may choose, for example "azure". Absent: any provider.

allowedOrigins.title: Allowed AI origins
allowedOrigins.description: Base URL origins, https only (http only for a loopback host), no path. Absent: any origin.

allowedModels.title: Allowed model ids
allowedModels.description: Model ids the user may use. Absent: any model at an allowed origin.

preset.title: Preset AI settings
preset.description: Values written into the user's settings and locked. A token set here is visible to the user in chrome://policy.

redactionFloor.title: Weakest redaction allowed
redactionFloor.description: The weakest redaction mode the user may choose.

allowCustomModels.title: Allow custom models
allowCustomModels.description: Whether the user may add their own models. Absent: false when any allow-list is set.

allowMcpBridge.title: Allow the MCP bridge
allowMcpBridge.description: Whether the MCP bridge may connect at all. Default true.

auditRetentionDays.title: Days to keep the KB send record

trustedPackKeys.title: Keys trusted for KB packs
trustedPackKeys.description: Public keys whose signed KB packs are used, besides the built-in ones (KB-RAG K23, D-SEC9). keyId is the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the SPKI DER; spki is that DER in base64.

revokedPackKeyIds.title: Revoked KB pack key ids
revokedPackKeyIds.description: Key ids never trusted, built-in ones included.

allowUnsignedPacks.title: Use unsigned KB packs
allowUnsignedPacks.description: For a transition only. Default false.

maxPackAgeDays.title: Longest life of a KB pack, in days
maxPackAgeDays.description: No pack is used more than this many days after it was built. 1 to 365.
